summary: Frontend-only E2E test of Childeric's new features (rappels, nouveau cycle, reprise en douceur, plan suggéré, gamification/badges). Ran full flow: onboarding -> bilan (answered p_loisirs, used overview sheet, verified segmented progress bar/Passer-Continuer labels/section celebration toast) -> plan-create (suggestion card appeared correctly, 'Utiliser' populated ambition/objective/action fields) -> plan created -> Today tab (toggle, all-done-banner, note, mood, close-day all working) -> Plan tab (no cycle-ended card right after creation, as expected) -> Suivi tab (Niveau + 10-item badge grid rendered) -> BadgeCelebration modal correctly auto-popped for 'Bilan accompli', 'Cap fixé' and 'Premier pas' and dismissed cleanly each time -> Réglages (time chips, test-notification button, export-summary, delete-all). All NEW feature UI states render correctly and no red-screen crashes occurred anywhere. Found 2 confirmed bugs (see below), both reproducible.

ui_bugs.issue: When navigating directly (fresh page load / deep link) to '/plan-create?mode=adjust' with an existing plan, the form does NOT prefill ambition/objective/action fields — all inputs render empty even after waiting 5+ seconds. 'Valider les ajustements' stays disabled (canCreate=false) so no crash/data-loss occurs, but the adjust flow is unusable from a direct/deep navigation.

After 'Oui, tout supprimer', router.replace('/') does NOT redirect to onboarding. The app stays inside the (tabs) navigator showing a broken/empty Today tab (no plan/settings, tab bar still visible) instead of the onboarding firstname screen. Root cause: both app/index.tsx (the gating redirect: settings->bilan->plan->tabs) and app/(tabs)/index.tsx resolve to the same '/' path; when router.replace('/') is called from a screen already inside the (tabs) group, expo-router resolves it to the tabs' own index (Today) rather than the root gating index.tsx, so the settings==null redirect-to-/onboarding logic never runs.

action_items: Fix plan-create.tsx adjust-mode prefill: replace the useState(isAdjust && state.plan ? ... : '') initializer pattern (which only evaluates once at mount, before the store has hydrated from storage on a fresh load) with a useEffect that syncs ambition/objectives from state.plan once `ready` becomes true and isAdjust is set, or gate the whole component render behind `ready` before initializing local state.

Fix delete-all navigation: since app/index.tsx and app/(tabs)/index.tsx both map to '/', consider renaming the root gating route (e.g. keep app/index.tsx as the single source of truth and make sure router.replace targets it specifically, e.g. router.dismissAll() + router.replace('/') from a screen OUTSIDE the tabs navigator, or use router.replace('/onboarding') directly after deleteAll() in reglages.tsx since we already know deletion always requires onboarding restart).

Re-test both fixes: (1) load /plan-create?mode=adjust directly after creating a plan and confirm fields prefill; (2) run delete-all from Réglages and confirm landing on the onboarding firstname screen with no tab bar visible.
critical_code_review_comments: plan-create.tsx: `const [ambition, setAmbition] = useState(isAdjust && state.plan ? state.plan.ambition : '')` and the analogous `objectives` useState are both susceptible to the stale-initializer bug above — confirmed via direct navigation test.

badges.ts / BadgeCelebration.tsx: well designed — the 'baseline on first load, celebrate only new unlocks' pattern works correctly and was verified for 'Bilan accompli', 'Cap fixé', and 'Premier pas'.
suggest.ts: pure, deterministic, no network calls — confirmed offline and correctly reflects answered questions (p_loisirs) into suggested action text.

index.tsx (root) vs (tabs)/index.tsx: both effectively resolve to path '/', which is the root cause of the delete-all navigation bug; this route ambiguity should be resolved (e.g. rename tabs default screen or always navigate with router.replace('/onboarding') explicitly instead of relying on '/' gating logic when already deep inside a nested navigator).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all new gamification/suggestion/reminder-settings/cycle UI features verified working; 2 confirmed bugs in adjust-mode deep-link prefill and post-delete navigation)

seed_data_creation: None. Used localStorage.clear() to reset state between test runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewport 390x844 on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL preview URL. IMPORTANT test-methodology note: whenever an action unlocks a badge (e.g. toggling the first action ever = 'Premier pas', finishing the bilan = 'Bilan accompli', creating first plan = 'Cap fixé'), a full-screen Modal pops up over the current screen; you MUST dismiss it via '[data-testid="badge-dismiss-button"]' before continuing, otherwise subsequent force=True clicks may hit the modal's Pressable backdrop (dismissing it) instead of your intended target, corrupting later assertions (I hit this myself on the first Today-tab run and had to redo it). Web browser Notification permission API returns denied/blocked immediately in this headless preview (canAskAgain=false from the start) — the reminder toggle/Alert.alert permission flow can't be fully exercised here, matches what was expected/documented by the requester. Bilan has 51 questions; fastest path to finish = spam-click bilan-next-button (label toggles Passer/Continuer based on whether current answer is filled) until it reads 'Terminer'. plan-create suggestion card only shows when the bilan has ANY non-empty answer AND form is pristine AND not in adjust mode.
rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (adjust-mode prefill): React's useState(initialValue) only evaluates initialValue on the component's first render. On a full page load, the AppStoreProvider hydrates plan/settings asynchronously from AsyncStorage/localStorage (via a useEffect + setState), so at the moment PlanCreate's useState runs, state.plan is still null, permanently baking empty strings into ambition/objectives — confirmed reproducible even after a 5s wait post-navigation (ruling out a timing race). Bug 2 (delete navigation): app/index.tsx and app/(tabs)/index.tsx both resolve to route '/'; calling router.replace('/') from Réglages (nested inside the tabs group) resolves relative to the current navigator and lands on the tabs' own home screen instead of triggering the root-level Index component's settings-null -> /onboarding redirect.
